title: Add Information to Existing Tickets
story: As a requestor, I want to add information to an existing ticket through the assistant, so that I can provide updates conversationally.

acceptanceCriteria.given: I provide additional information for an existing ticket
acceptanceCriteria.then: the information is saved as a customer-visible comment

acceptanceCriteria.given: a comment is added to a ticket
acceptanceCriteria.then: the assigned fulfiller receives a notification of the update

acceptanceCriteria.given: I attempt to update a closed ticket
acceptanceCriteria.then: I receive an explanation and an option to create a new ticket

edgeCases: Updating a ticket assigned to a different team
Adding an attachment through the assistant
Very long comment exceeding character limits
Updating a ticket that was escalated
Concurrent updates to the same ticket
